workItem.title: Verify requirement-only work and report test completeness honestly

requirements.statement: Quality must be able to verify a work item that has requirements but no User Story, from executed checks bound to the requirement's acceptance criteria, with a verdict that never reaches PASS unless every acceptance criterion has a passing executed scenario.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: verify-stories on a work item with no Stories runs the project checks that name a requirementId and records coverage without a storyId.
An acceptance criterion with no passing executed scenario produces reason ac-not-verified:<criterionId> and caps the requirement verdict at PASS_WITH_RISKS.
Every acceptance criterion covered by a passing scenario and no failing scenario yields PASS for a requirement-only item, since there is no Story to confirm.
A failing scenario yields FAIL and a Developer finding.
With neither Stories nor checks, verification reports missing evidence and does not pass.
verify-stories no longer writes any file at preview time.

requirements.statement: A green test run must mean everything that is supposed to run did run: tests that are excluded, skipped or silently not collected must be explicit and justified, and a test must not pass by returning early when its precondition is missing.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A check script fails when a workspace has test files but no test script, or a test script is missing where --if-present would silently skip it.
A check script fails when a test script excludes a test file or a test uses skip/todo without an entry and reason in an allowlist file.
A check script fails when a test returns early on a missing directory or file instead of asserting or being explicitly skipped.
Every allowlist entry that no longer matches anything fails the check, so exclusions cannot go stale.
The check runs as part of the repository verify flow and reports each finding with file and reason.
The existing exclusion of quality-ensure.test.ts is either removed or justified in the allowlist.

openQuestions: Is an acceptance criterion with no bound check a risk or a failure? Proposed: risk (ac-not-verified), because absence of a check is not evidence of failure.

nextActions: Runtime: checks without Story, no preview write
Completeness guard script, allowlists and wiring in core and runtime

decisions.statement: Requirement-only verification: CoverageEntrySchema.storyId becomes optional. requirementEvidence treats entries without storyId as requirement-level evidence for that requirement. When a requirement has no linked current Story, every acceptance criterion of the requirement must be covered by a PASS scenario naming it via acceptanceCriterionId; uncovered criteria add reason ac-not-verified:<id> and cap at PASS_WITH_RISKS; with all criteria covered and no FAIL the verdict is PASS (nothing to confirm). Linked Stories keep their confirmation rules unchanged. runProjectChecks no longer requires a Story: story fields come from the check when present, and a check naming neither storyId nor requirementId fails the check file as CHECKS_INVALID. buildStoryVerification no longer throws STORY_MISSING when requirements exist; with neither Stories nor requirements it still throws, and with no checks it falls back to the inspection plan whose scenarios are NOT_VERIFIED (never PASS). Remove the preview-time last-verification.json write. Test completeness: new tools/scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs in each repository with tests, driven by test-completeness.allowlist.json {entries:[{kind,path,pattern?,reason}]}, kinds: no-test-script, exclude, skip, early-return. It scans package.json test scripts and test sources, fails on any finding not allowlisted with a non-empty reason and on any allowlist entry that matches nothing. Wired into the repository verify script. quality-ensure.test.ts exclusion: justify or remove after measuring.

implementationUnits.summary: praxis-core a2ede10: optional coverage storyId; requirementEvidence requires every acceptance criterion for requirement-only PASS (ac-not-verified). praxis-core 83d2953 + praxis-runtime bdf1b04: check-test-completeness guard (check:tests in verify), test:security wiring for 3 approval-broker script tests that npm test never ran, quality-ensure exclusion replaced by 5 visible justified skips, validate-plugins early-return fixed. praxis-runtime: runProjectChecks without Story, EVIDENCE_MISSING, removed unauthorized preview-time last-verification.json write. Tests: requirement-only-evidence.test.ts (8), requirement-only.test.ts (6), check-test-completeness.test.mjs (11); negative controls verified.

history.note: Quality cannot verify a work item that has requirements but no User Story: verify-stories throws STORY_MISSING and the coverage schema requires a storyId, so requirement-only items can never reach a requirement verdict from executed evidence. Separately, test runs can look green while parts did not run: a workspace test script excludes a whole test file, a test returns early when a directory is missing, and --if-present silently skips workspaces without tests. verify-stories also writes .praxis/
